notes: Improved serial and TCP raw-data capture reliability for mixed ASCII and binary streams.
Raw bytes are written with priority while complete NMEA and ComNav ASCII logs remain available for terminal preview and parsing.
Binary fragments are excluded from terminal preview and text parsing to prevent garbled output and reduce UI load.
Improved timestamp rendering for fragmented ASCII log lines.
Fixed persistent language selection and status-bar translations.
GitHub is now the preferred update source, with the Qtalis official site used as a fallback.
